extracted.name: Slow Cooker Caramelized Onions
extracted.description: Make beautifully caramelized onions in your slow cooker with this easy recipe. Ideal for soups, burgers, omelets, pizzas, and more.
instruction_lines: Rub bottom and sides of slow cooker with 1/2 of the butter. Toss onions and salt with remaining butter in a bowl.
Cook onions on Low until browned and sweet, about 10 hours.
